reasoning: The icon is a UI toggle state ('eraser off' / disable eraser tool) shown as a tilted block eraser cut by a diagonal slash. At list size the broken outline is hard to parse as an eraser and easily mistaken for a crossed-out tag, and 'no-eraser' is an app tool state rather than a meaningful subject for everyday to-do items.
